title: The Regressed Son of a Duke is an Assassin
altTitles: The Reborn Young Lord Is an Assassin
The Regressed Youngest Son of the Duke Is an Assassin
The Regressed Youngest Son of the Duke is an Assassin
description: Cyan Vert, the best assassin on the continent, meets a tragic death after being betrayed by his own brother. Just before his death, he is given another chance at life and awakens in his younger body. Determined to live for himself this time, Cyan abandons the shadow he once lived in and begins forging his own path while using the skills and experience of his previous life.
author: Coffee Lime / Swing Bat
